clips.title: The story
paras: Poison Water begins the tauren effort to purge pollution from Mulgore's sacred wells. Entrusted by Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village, young Horde defenders gather natural components from the plains to craft a restorative ritual totem.

The grassy plains of Mulgore are sacred ground to the tauren, but insidious forces have begun threatening their vital lifeblood. Mull Thunderhorn, an elder stationed in Bloodhoof Village, discovers that goblin interlopers and their lackeys have tainted the precious water wells that sustain the tribes and the local wildlife. The pollution strikes directly at the spiritual heart of the nomadic people who recently settled here.

To counteract industrial contaminants, Mull relies on traditional tauren shamanism rather than crude remedies. Cleansing the Winterhoof Water Well requires crafting a potent ritual totem imbued with the vitality of Mulgore's indigenous predators. He sends hunters to track prairie wolves for their paws and mature plainstriders for their talons across the southwestern plains, enlisting the strength of the land to heal its own wounds.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Goblins and their servants have tainted our sacred water wells! We cannot allow this.
To cleanse each well, I must create a cleansing totem, then you must bring the totem to the well and perform a cleansing ritual.

First we will create a cleansing totem for the Winterhoof Water Well. To do this, the land must offer its aid. Hunt prairie wolves for their paws and adult plainstriders for their talons. They are to the southwest.
Return to me with the paws and talons, friend.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the paws and talons, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done well, friend. I will take these and bind their power into a totem of cleansing.
